scope:
Paired same-shape native model qualification; stream CPU snapshots, no TPS.

Two GPU instances run the same pinned artifact and schedule. The reference is
chunked FP16 dequant+cuBLAS, not an original-BF16/corpus oracle. No inference
weights/KV are offloaded to host; CPU copies exist only for validation.

projection_info.projection_precision_scope: Original per-matrix encoded weights/scales; Q4/Q5/Q6 auto/reference A16 decode q*scale with FP16 rounding before FP32 accumulation; separately gated fused Q4 research retains FP32 group-scale association. Actual per-codec family/rounding is reported in linear_contracts. int8 explicitly uses one group32 activation Q8 pass; torch.float16 storage/KV, FP32 GDN. q8-residual uses explicit group32 activation high/residual Q8 passes with FP32 scales and changed reduction order; not original FP16 arithmetic.
